banner.label: Cookie and storage notice
banner.title: We only use what's strictly necessary
banner.body: This site stores the theme and language you choose on your device, plus your own decision about this notice — nothing else. Today we don't install any analytics or third-party cookies. Accepting or rejecting doesn't change anything that already works.

preferences.title: Cookie preferences
preferences.intro: Here you can see, category by category, what this site stores on your device and why. The necessary category can't be turned off: without it the site can't remember your theme or your language.
preferences.alwaysOn: Always on — required for the site to work, can't be turned off.
preferences.emptyCategory: No technology currently declared in this category.

necessary.name: Necessary
necessary.description: Storage required for the site to work: remembering your theme, your language, and your own consent decision.

analytics.name: Analytics
analytics.description: The analytics planned for this site is cookieless and isn't installed yet. Once it is, it will be declared here before it's turned on.

marketing.name: Marketing
marketing.description: This site doesn't use, and has no plans to use, any marketing or advertising storage or cookies.

vti-theme.name: Theme (light / dark)
vti-theme.purpose: Remembers whether you chose the light or dark theme, so you're not asked again on every visit.

vti-lang.name: Language
vti-lang.purpose: Remembers the language you chose (Spanish or English), so you're not asked again on every visit.

vti-consent.name: Cookie decision
vti-consent.purpose: Stores your own decision about this cookie notice, so it isn't shown again on every visit.
